lines.text: A Levite couple has a son, and the mother hides him for three months.
She places the child in a tar-coated papyrus basket among the reeds, and his sister watches from a distance.
Pharaoh's daughter bathes in the Jordan, finds the crying baby in the basket, and has compassion on him.
The sister offers to call a Hebrew nurse, brings the boy's mother, and Pharaoh's daughter promises her wages.
The grown boy becomes the daughter's son, and she names him Aaron because she drew him out of the water.
